name: Verde River (below Bartlett Dam)
gaugeName: Verde River below Bartlett Dam, AZ
blurb: Short dam-release reach below Bartlett Lake in the Tonto NF. Riverside (upstream) is closed until Mar 31, 2027. Box Bar is the last Tonto NF take-out used here.

sections.notes: Miles (1.9) are NHD High Resolution centreline-routed between the agency points; no agency mileage found. Bald eagle seasonal closures Dec 1-Jun 30 at both sites (Tonto NF). Box Bar is the last Tonto NF river access used in this package; access below it was not researched. Riverside Campground upstream is CLOSED until Mar 31, 2027 (order 03-12-01-26-24).

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
